messages:
carla: Canary failing in ap-south after helm promote. Scheduler can't place pods.
omar: paste scheduler event?
carla: `0/10 nodes are available: 10 node(s) didn't match node selector.`
nick: chart v5.0 introduced a new `values.nodeSelector.accelerator: nvidia-tesla` for the GPU sidecar feature, intended for batch clusters only. Looks like promoter applied it globally.
infra: we didn't enable GPU nodes in ap-south cluster. The nodeSelector makes the pods unschedulable.
carla: deploy-bot flagged canary unhealthy and halted promotion. @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: Canary 3750000000-ap-south paused due to Pending (0/10 nodes match). Action: hold and notify release-ops.
release-ops: decision: rollback chart in ap-south, apply regional override to remove nodeSelector, or provision GPU nodes quickly. Change window ~30m.
omar: provisioning GPUs will take >2h, not an option. Rolling back loses the GPU-sidecar feature we want in other regions. Regional override to remove nodeSelector is fast and reversible.
nick: agree. I'll prepare an overrides file: `overrides/ap-south-remove-accel.yaml` with `nodeSelector: {}` and `sidecar.enabled=false` to be safe.
carla: annotate release with `temp-regional-remove-nodeSelector` and add `temp-unpin-by=3750003600` metadata so we unpin after infra enables accelerators.
deploy-bot: queued job 3750000015 by nick: `deploy-bot promote --env ap-south --overrides overrides/ap-south-remove-accel.yaml --annotate "temp-regional-remove-nodeSelector"`
deploy-bot: Running preflight -> validating schema -> applying overrides -> helm upgrade. ETA ~90s.
carla: pods are scheduling now, readiness probes passing. Kicking off smoke tests.
deploy-bot: smoke tests passed. Canary healthy after regional override. :white_check_mark:
release-ops: recorded decision: apply regional override to remove nodeSelector; no rollback. Follow-up actions: 1) infra to evaluate GPU capacity in ap-south and timeline; 2) add gating rule to promotion pipeline to prevent global application of nodeSelector values unless region-capacity check passes; 3) add chart PR checklist item reminding authors to call out nodeSelector changes and region availability.
infra: noted. We'll assess capacity and report ETA. If GPUs can be provisioned within ETA, release team will schedule unpin, otherwise keep override until next scheduled maintenance.
omar: I'll add the release note entry under Known Issues explaining the regional override and rationale. Also creating a small CI check to validate nodeSelector availability across promoted regions.
carla: leaving the release annotation `temp-regional-remove-nodeSelector` and `unpin-ETA=3750003600`. Thanks all. Close thread once unpin is complete.
